text_block_list.text: It was one early afternoon—
(Boom-cha-cha, boom-cha...)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...What is this cheerful rhythm?

It is not merely 'something'! This is the 
rhythm of the sun that flows through the 
Condor!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Shocking, stunning, surprise! El Condor 
Pasa has maaaade her entrance!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
*sigh* I knew it was you. El Condor 
Pasaâ

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And this dance floor is watched over by 
angels! Come, let us unveil our 
magnificent dance!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: !? They multiplied!?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Non-non! It's not over yet! Liberate your 
soul with the world's best contemporary 
dance!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno! An open dance battle has begun! If 
you don't start dancing soon, you're gonna 
lose!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huh... What!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Or is King just going to watch? Well, 
that has its own charm, I suppose!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If you've decided to forfeit, then this 
Condor will simply take her leave! Ciao☆

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
“......Huh? Forfeit by default? ...King, 
losing without even putting up a fight?”

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"W-Wait up! I'll show you the first-class 
dance moves I've spent years polishing, 
too—!!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! That's King for you! Your 
indomitable spirit is alive and weeeeell!
(Boom-cha-cha, boom-cha...)
(...Cha-cha... thrum-thrum...)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Gyaaah!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, there's... nobody here? Then was 
that just... a dream?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
*sigh* Seeing something so weird like 
that... I must be really exhausted.
(Boom-cha-cha, boom-cha...)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Because that music is still echoing in my 
head...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Wait, why can I still hear it!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that I've unlocked a whole new 
world...? Well, if that's the case--

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Just what have I awakened to～!? What is 
wrong with me～!?

Later on, King Halo could be seen running 
with much more rhythm... and sharpness 
than before!
